kind: Post hoc hindsight final-interval recovery diagnostic, declared after the campaign started
selection: Completed episodes with terminal_feasible false; incomplete episodes are listed and skipped
scan: 101 uniformly spaced constant feeds in [0,min(.2,(1.8-V)/2)] L/h; one unique zero feed if no volume remains
solver: Frozen reactor, tight DOP853 rtol2e-10 atol2e-12 maxstep.1h
information: True saved state at stage6 and true final plant affinity used only offline after the executed policy outcomes
interpretation: A found feasible feed is a model-based recovery witness. No sampled feasible recovery does not prove physical unreachability. Earlier policies create different final-interval states.
cost: Diagnostic time and model calls are entirely separate from primary controller costs; no optimization is rerun for the earlier intervals
